crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Approximately triangular, high-contrast white patch on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear color transition from the black crown to the white nape patch and back to the dark mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent rufous/orange-colored patches visible on the posterior lateral/flank areas, contrasting sharply with the dark dorsal plumage.
